title: 11: Git, GitHub & GitHub Actions Workflow
subtitle: Verify the integrated source-control and CI simulators in one realistic Java developer flow.

steps.title: Open the Java Practice repository in Git
steps.why: Developer local repository ni Git lo open chestadu. Working tree, current branch, remotes, staged changes mariyu commit history ikkada manage chestam.

steps.title: Review the Student.java diff
steps.why: Commit cheyyadaniki mundu exact source changes ni diff lo review chestam. Added and removed lines ni verify chesi accidental changes avoid chestam.

steps.title: Stage Student.java for commit
steps.why: Reviewed file ni staging area ki move chestam. Git lo commit ki include kavalsina exact changes ni staging separate chestundi.

steps.title: Inspect local Git commit history
steps.why: Local repository history lo previous commits, hashes, branches mariyu project progression ni verify chestam.

steps.title: Open the Java Practice repository on GitHub
steps.why: Local Git work remote collaboration ki GitHub lo kanipistundi. Repository files, branches, commits, issues, pull requests mariyu settings remote side lo manage chestam.

steps.title: Review pull request number 2
steps.why: Feature branch ni main branch tho merge cheyyadaniki mundu pull request lo discussion, checks, reviewers mariyu changed files ni inspect chestam.

steps.title: Inspect repository security
steps.why: GitHub Security area lo dependency alerts, code scanning, secret scanning mariyu repository security posture ni review cheyyachu.

steps.title: Open GitHub Actions
steps.why: Repository automation ni GitHub Actions lo inspect chestam. Workflow YAML, triggers, jobs, runners, secrets, caches mariyu environments ikkada manage chestam.

steps.title: Inspect successful Java CI run 42
steps.why: CI run lo jobs and individual steps expand chesi checkout, Java setup, Maven verification, logs, annotations mariyu artifacts successful ga complete ayyayo verify chestam.

steps.title: Inspect GitHub Actions secrets and variables
steps.why: CI/CD credentials ni source code lo hard-code cheyyakunda repository secrets use chestam. Non-sensitive configuration values kosam Actions variables separate ga maintain chestam.
